episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Wolfe shares his journey from a failed house flipping business to becoming a top-producing REALTOR in a new market. He discusses the importance of open houses and cold calling for lead generation, the power of consistent daily routines, and the use of systems like Activate Daily to stay organized. Chris offers actionable insights for agents looking to build or rebuild their business from the ground up.
